sources.title: Adopted plans — North East Enfield Area Action Plan
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's adopted Core Strategy identifies the north-east of the borough as a strategic growth area; the Area Action Plan identifies opportunity sites and infrastructure and is intended to direct investment, redevelopment, housing, jobs and community facilities.

sources.title: Rainham and Beam Park
sources.verified_claim: Havering describes Rainham and Beam Park as a Housing Zone planned for 3,500 homes over 10–15 years and states Beam Park Station is pivotal to more than 5,000 homes and wider London Riverside regeneration.

sources.title: Sustainable growth
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's strategy links opportunity areas and major town centres with public-realm investment, employment growth and commercial activity, and calls for transport capacity/access improvements at Waterloo, Vauxhall and Brixton.
